llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed wrapper for a third-party image-generation CLI, with expected network use, API-key storage, and optional media uploads clearly described.

dimensions.detail: Network access to api.dlazy.com and files.dlazy.com, local media-file reads when paths are supplied, and result saving are proportionate for a cloud image-generation tool and are disclosed in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill declares npm/npx use of pinned package @dlazy/cli@1.2.3, provides provenance links, and offers npx as a non-global alternative; installing a third-party CLI remains a normal user trust decision.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases include generic image-generation wording, which could cause broad activation, but the runtime instructions stay within using the documented dlazy banana2 command and handling normal authentication or billing errors.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Authentication can persist an API key in ~/.dlazy/config.json and a global npm install can persist the CLI binary, but both behaviors are documented and no background service, privilege escalation, or hidden persistence is described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Nano Banana 2.0 image generation and editing, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: send prompts and parameters to dLazy, optionally upload user-provided media paths, and return hosted generated outputs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust dLazy and are comfortable with prompts and selected image/media files being sent to its hosted service. Prefer npx or review the pinned CLI before a global install, and use revocable API keys or per-invocation DLAZY_API_KEY if you do not want a saved local config key.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced bilingual file was present in the workspace and inspected, so the coverage concern did not reveal hidden or unavailable behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad image-related triggers are purpose-aligned but should be treated as a usability/control caveat because invocation may call a credentialed cloud service or upload user-supplied file paths.
[P9] expected: The reported whitespace occurs in wide Markdown error tables; manual inspection did not find concealed instructions or content after the padding.
